label: MARKETING TERM
headline: Content Marketing
body: Content marketing is about creating and sharing valuable, relevant content to attract and keep a clear audience, guiding them towards a desired action.
caption:
Instead of just selling, you share helpful blog posts, videos, or social media updates that your audience finds useful. For example, a handmade jewelry seller might post a video on how to care for silver, or a freelancer could write an article on managing client expectations. This builds trust and shows you're an expert. Think about what helpful content you could create today!
